status: proposed supplement for root review; not approved. Experiment definition only: no pocold, Node or chain run exists or is claimed.

hookProtocol.hookPoint: The fetchEach tool's external sink handles each sink call before returning. The hook is armed for one event: 'piece(attempt, seq)' or 'begin(attempt)'. When that event arrives the handler does not return until the hook completes. LogClient sends its next request only after the sink call has returned.
hookProtocol.fallbackIfSinkNotAwaited: If the TypeScript LogClient does not await sink calls, the hook instead holds the next outgoing pocol_getLogs or eth_getBlockByNumber of the LogClient connection at the HTTP layer (RpcTap.hold) until the hook completes; the run records hookMode = 'transport'. The pass criteria are unchanged.
hookProtocol.submit: The harness delivers the target branch's blocks (B: 1000'..1080'; A': its fixture blocks from 1000) to the tested pocold from the fixture node that holds them, over the normal block-import path. Nothing goes through the LogClient connection.
hookProtocol.adoptionSignal: A separate control connection (tag 'control' in RpcRecorder, excluded from the LogClient counters) polls eth_getBlockByNumber('latest', false) every 100 ms. Adoption = the returned hash equals the target branch head hash recorded by the fixture builder.
hookProtocol.timeLimit: 120000 ms from the submit. No adoption within the limit: the run is INCONCLUSIVE(setupTimeout); it is repeated, never counted as PASS.
preconditions: Attempt 1 must have at least 4 pieces in total for the 'after the third piece' hook to leave a log request: 1024 blocks of about 32 KiB (validation.md:985) give about 32 MiB, and every reply is <= 8 MiB, so at least 4 replies. If attempt 1 commits with <= 3 pieces before the hook fires, the run is INVALID(setup).
work(B) > work(A) and work(A') > work(B) (validation.md:986-987); otherwise the fixture build reports 'tie' and the run is INVALID(setup).

modelAnalogue.note: Executed by tools/run_checks_025.py on the accepted 0.19 reference LogClient and MockLogServer (lc-data.json branches A, B, Ap; head 3000; three 1024-block pieces). The hook is a branch switch inside the matching sink call. The model has only three pieces, so 'after the third piece' is detected by the pre-commit head check H(3000), and the mid-attempt anchorNotCanonical path is exercised by a hook after the second piece.
